verdict.rationale: Typesense publishes version-specific documentation: a navbar dropdown switches between versions, and API reference pages sit under a /docs/latest/api/ path. This suggests the API surface is documented per release, but nothing in the pack describes an explicit API versioning scheme or any deprecation policy. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with timelines and notice periods, an explicit API versioning or compatibility guarantee, a changelog of breaking changes, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: When you're viewing any of the versions, you can click on the version dropdown in the Navbar to switch between versions.
